events.title: Ethereum BPO2 raises blob target and maximum
events.summary: The second Fusaka Blob Parameter Only fork activated on Ethereum mainnet at epoch 419,072, increasing the blob target to 14 and maximum to 21.
events.significance: BPO2 demonstrated Ethereum's new ability to scale rollup data capacity through lightweight parameter-only forks instead of waiting for a full network upgrade cycle.

events.title: EU-wide MiCA transitional ceiling expires for crypto service providers
events.summary: MiCA Article 143 allowed qualifying pre-existing crypto-asset service providers to continue under transitional arrangements only until 1 July 2026 at the latest, though individual member states could end their national transitional periods earlier.
events.significance: The date marked the end of the EU-wide maximum grandfathering window and made MiCA authorization the baseline for continuing covered crypto-asset services across the EU.

sources.title: ESMA — Statement on end of MiCA transitional periods

events.title: Ethereum Glamsterdam upgrade
events.summary: Ethereum currently expects Glamsterdam on mainnet in Q4 2026, but no mainnet date is confirmed as of 26 September 2026. Testing is ongoing and the next listed milestone is Sepolia on 6 October.
events.significance: Do not treat this as a historical event yet. If it ships, its planned features include enshrined proposer-builder separation and block-level access lists.
events.notes: Excluded from card scoring until mainnet activation occurs.
